sessions.phase_label: Source review, security remediation, and deployment dispute

requirements.title: Web Application
requirements.definition: Provide an independently usable web application for the billing system.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers web availability only; mobile, desktop, and administration experiences are separate deliverables.

requirements.title: Mobile Application
requirements.definition: Provide the billing application for Android and iOS mobile devices.
requirements.boundary_note: Android and iOS are platform attributes of the mobile client; store publication is a separate deployment obligation.

requirements.title: Desktop Application
requirements.definition: Provide the billing application for Windows and macOS desktop platforms.
requirements.boundary_note: Windows and macOS support is explicitly included in the mandatory Flutter platform list and is independent of web and mobile availability.

requirements.title: Administration Interface
requirements.definition: Provide an administration interface for managing the billing system.
requirements.boundary_note: The admin experience is independently required and is not merged into the general web application.

requirements.title: Multi-Company Support
requirements.definition: Allow the billing system to represent and operate multiple companies with company-specific data.
requirements.boundary_note: Company tenancy is independent of supporting multiple user accounts within a company.

requirements.title: Multi-User Support
requirements.definition: Allow multiple users to access and use the billing system.
requirements.boundary_note: User multiplicity can evolve independently of multi-company data partitioning.

requirements.title: Invoice Management
requirements.definition: Provide the core ability to create and maintain billing and invoice records.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers only the core invoice-record mechanism; templates, GST, file exchange, PDF generation, and sharing are separate behaviors.

requirements.title: Optional Indian GST Support
requirements.definition: Support Indian GST invoice behavior as an optional mode rather than requiring it for every invoice.
requirements.boundary_note: GST calculation and representation are independently configurable business rules, not attributes of visual invoice templates.

requirements.title: Multiple Invoice Templates
requirements.definition: Provide multiple selectable templates for rendering invoices.
requirements.boundary_note: Template selection and rendering can change independently of invoice data and PDF sharing.

requirements.title: Invoice Data Import
requirements.definition: Import billing or invoice data from CSV, XLS, and XLSX files.
requirements.boundary_note: Supported file formats are attributes of one import mechanism; export is independently testable and remains separate.

requirements.title: Invoice Data Export
requirements.definition: Export billing or invoice data to CSV, XLS, and XLSX files.
requirements.boundary_note: Supported file formats are attributes of one export mechanism; export can succeed or fail independently of import.

requirements.title: PDF Invoice Generation
requirements.definition: Generate a PDF representation of an invoice.
requirements.boundary_note: PDF creation is independent of distributing an already generated PDF.

requirements.title: PDF Invoice Sharing
requirements.definition: Provide a share action for PDF invoices through WhatsApp, Gmail, links, and comparable system share targets.
requirements.boundary_note: The channels are attributes of one sharing mechanism; generation of the PDF remains a separate prerequisite behavior.

requirements.title: Automatic Daily Backup
requirements.definition: Automatically create a backup of application data each day.
requirements.boundary_note: The daily schedule is an attribute of automatic backup; restoration is a separately executable recovery behavior.

requirements.title: Backup Restoration
requirements.definition: Restore application data from a retained backup.
requirements.boundary_note: Restore success can be implemented and verified independently of automatic backup scheduling.

requirements.title: Responsive Interface
requirements.definition: Ensure the user interface adapts appropriately across supported screen sizes and device classes.
requirements.boundary_note: Responsive layout behavior is independently testable from visual elegance, colors, and typography.

requirements.title: Professional Visual Design
requirements.definition: Use an elegant, professional visual style and color treatment throughout the application.
requirements.boundary_note: General style and color direction form one visual-design constraint; typography has its own failure and change trajectory.

requirements.title: Professional Typography
requirements.definition: Use typography with a professional appearance and avoid excessively heavy fonts.
requirements.boundary_note: Font family and weight can be modified and evaluated independently of the broader color and layout style.

requirements.title: Email OTP Delivery
requirements.definition: Deliver authentication one-time passwords through an email service.
requirements.boundary_note: The OTP behavior is distinct from the unresolved choice of SendGrid, Hostinger, or a configurable provider.

requirements.title: Flutter Frontend
requirements.definition: Implement supported client applications using Flutter.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the mandatory frontend technology choice; availability of each client application remains independently testable.

requirements.title: NestJS TypeScript Backend
requirements.definition: Implement the backend service using NestJS and TypeScript.
requirements.boundary_note: The backend framework choice can change independently of the database, cache, or client framework.

requirements.title: Redis Integration
requirements.definition: Include Redis as part of the required application architecture.
requirements.boundary_note: Redis is an independently mandated infrastructure technology even though its detailed use is not visible in the supplied history.

requirements.title: Database Schema and Migrations
requirements.definition: Deliver the database schema and executable migrations needed to create and evolve the application database.
requirements.boundary_note: This concerns independently required executable database artifacts rather than merely selecting PostgreSQL and Prisma.

requirements.title: Production-Ready Code Quality
requirements.definition: Deliver clean, scalable, documented, reviewed, tested, secure, and production-ready code, including verification of any AI-assisted code.
requirements.boundary_note: These are tightly related implementation acceptance constraints; concrete security controls and documentation deliverables remain separate.

requirements.title: Application Security
requirements.definition: Treat application and data security as a major implementation constraint.
requirements.boundary_note: Captures the explicit cross-cutting security constraint; repository confidentiality and exposed-endpoint remediation have separate lifecycles.

requirements.title: Source Repository Confidentiality
requirements.definition: Keep the project source repository private rather than publicly exposing the codebase.
requirements.boundary_note: Repository visibility can be corrected independently and does not by itself remediate information already exposed through the repository.

requirements.title: Exposed API Endpoint Remediation
requirements.definition: Replace API endpoints or paths that were exposed through the public repository.
requirements.boundary_note: This one-off remediation remains necessary even after repository privacy is restored.

requirements.title: Docker Deployment
requirements.definition: Provide a deployable Docker and Docker Compose configuration for the complete system.
requirements.boundary_note: Containerized deployability is a persistent project artifact; performing a particular server deployment is a separate task.

requirements.title: Live Test Environment
requirements.definition: Host a live, accessible instance so the non-technical client can test the application.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently requested operational environment, not a generic testing-process Requirement or the final production deployment.

requirements.title: Ubuntu VPS Deployment
requirements.definition: Deploy the complete project to the client's Ubuntu VPS.
requirements.boundary_note: Actual deployment to the client server is independent of supplying Docker files, a temporary test host, or store publication.

requirements.title: Google Play Publication
requirements.definition: Publish the Android mobile application through the client's Google Play developer account.
requirements.boundary_note: Google Play publication has a platform-specific release process independent of Apple App Store publication.

requirements.title: Apple App Store Publication
requirements.definition: Publish the iOS mobile application through the client's Apple App Store developer account.
requirements.boundary_note: Apple publication has its own build, signing, and review path and can evolve independently of Google Play publication.

requirements.title: Complete Source Code Delivery
requirements.definition: Deliver the complete source code for the web, mobile, backend, and other implemented project components.
requirements.boundary_note: Source delivery is an independently required artifact and is not satisfied merely by claiming that the applications were implemented.

requirements.title: API Documentation
requirements.definition: Deliver documentation describing the backend API and how it is used.
requirements.boundary_note: API reference material is distinct from deployment steps and general project setup instructions.

requirements.title: Step-by-Step Deployment Guide
requirements.definition: Deliver a step-by-step document that enables an administrator to deploy the project.
requirements.boundary_note: The guide is an independently requested artifact and does not substitute for performing the requested deployments.

requirements.title: Setup Guide and README
requirements.definition: Deliver a README and setup guide explaining how to configure and run the project.
requirements.boundary_note: README and setup instructions are tightly coupled onboarding artifacts; server deployment procedures and API reference material remain separate.

requirements.title: PostgreSQL Database
requirements.boundary_note: Changed by consistency audit.

requirements.title: Prisma ORM Data Access
requirements.boundary_note: Changed by consistency audit.
